# Meta Blueprint

> > Meta Blueprint is a free digital marketing learning platform offering courses and certifications on Meta's advertising tools, social media marketing, and campaign optimization.

Meta Blueprint provides comprehensive training on Facebook Ads Manager, Instagram, Reels, and advanced targeting features like Advantage+ audiences. The platform serves individual marketers, agencies, and businesses seeking to develop skills in digital advertising and social media marketing.

## Key Topics

- Meta Ads Manager
- Facebook Ads
- Campaign Optimization
- Advantage+ Audience
- Reels
- Audience Targeting
- Digital Marketing
- Ad Optimization
- Instagram Ads
- Social Media Marketing
- Opportunity Score
- Facebook Pages
- Ad Fragmentation
- Partnership Ads
- Skill Development

## Course Catalogs & Learning Paths

- [Meta Blueprint Homepage](https://www.facebookblueprint.com): Main entry point for Meta Blueprint digital marketing skill development and course discovery
- [Course Catalog](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/catalog): Main course catalog for Meta Blueprint digital marketing training
- [Browse All Topics](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/catalog/browse): Browseable course topics covering advertising and marketing skills
- [Course List View](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/catalog/list): Listed course catalog for Meta Blueprint digital marketing training
- [Training Workshops](https://trainingworkshops.facebookblueprint.com/student/catalog): Training workshops and webinars for Meta advertising and certification
- [Agency Courses](https://agencies.facebookblueprint.com/student/catalog): Meta Blueprint courses for agencies on ads, Reels, and certification

## Ads Manager & Campaign Fundamentals

- [Get Started with Ads Manager](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/activity/415305-get-started-with-ads-manager): Beginner guide to Meta Ads Manager for campaign creation
- [Create Ads from a Facebook Page](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/activity/415308-create-ads-from-a-facebook-page): Tutorial on creating Facebook ads from a Business Page
- [How to Create a Facebook Page](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/activity/409145-how-to-create-a-facebook-page): Step-by-step guide to creating a Facebook Business Page
- [How to Post on a Facebook Page](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/activity/409148-how-to-post-on-a-facebook-page): Tutorial on posting content to Facebook Pages for engagement

## Audience Targeting & Optimization

- [Use Advantage+ Audience](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/activity/688313-advantage-plus-audiences): Guide to Advantage+ audience targeting for Facebook ads
- [Understanding Ad Fragmentation](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/activity/688315-ad-fragmentation): Tutorial on reducing ad fragmentation for better ad optimization
- [Introduction to Opportunity Score](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/activity/691057-opportunity-score-intro-video): Video tutorial on Opportunity Score for campaign optimization

## Creative Formats & Placements

- [Include Reels Placements in Your Campaigns](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/activity/691040-reels-placement-explanation-video): Tutorial on using Reels ad placements for campaign performance
- [Increase Campaign Performance with Partnership Ads](https://www.facebookblueprint.com/student/page/612967-increase-campaign-performance-with-partnership-ads): Course on partnership ads and creator collaborations in Meta Ads
